doc.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Art Martigan and the Crystal Lounge: first job with Wardell Gray
summary: Going to Detroit he met drummer Art Martigan, who handed him the six-night Crystal Lounge job with Wardell Gray.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: So at this point were you learning to play with anybody in combos or ensembles or anything like that?

Oh no, not yet. I started later on I guess. I started to go to Detroit. Cause there was nothing in Pontiac. Just a lot of drinking! I went to Detroit and I met Art Martigan and Art Martigan was playing with Wardell Gray and he – I’d go back to that club and listen to him. And he played so smoothly. He had a very, very beautiful technique and he looked relaxed he wasn’t sweating. He knew how to handle it. It’s a matter of learning how to breathe when you play. It’s like breathing when you’re swimming.
It was called “Crystal Lounge” It was right on the Grand River where the Red Wings stadium was right on the corner, across the street from that.
And was it a nightclub, was it a dinner club?

It was a bar you know. They had a little bandstand and Wardell Gray played there. So Art—I sat in a couple of times. And he said, “Listen I got another job. You take this one”. So that’s how I started to work.
How did you meet Art first? By going to the club?

Yes by going to the club. I sat down and I didn’t know him. I just sat down and listen. I didn’t come there to meet anybody I came there to listen to the music. But he was such a gentleman. He’d come to the table and say “Hey, I hadn’t seen you sitting here before.” So he introduced himself and I introduced myself. And he said “Hey you play drums?” and I said, “Yeah I’m trying!” You know there are always some nice people that you think when nothing is going to ever happen—here it is! They drop it right in your lap.
So you took over his chair at the crystal lounge? So you were playing nightly?
So your first professional gig was playing with Wardell Gray?
Oh yeah (laughs) I had a job.
